data.description:
# Documentation integration for the classic arcade arsenal

Part of epic **New power-ups and weapons from classic arcade games** (AH-0MV14SO0G0095IJ4).
Depends on every implemented concept child. Cross-cutting docs slice: after the concepts ship, the repo's user-facing documentation must reference the research document and list the new arsenal, so the direction is discoverable and traceable.

## User story

As a developer or player reading the documentation, I want the README, the Game Design Document and the power-up/weapon documentation to reference `docs/CLASSIC_POWERUP_WEAPON_RESEARCH.md` and list the new classic-arcade arsenal, so the roster direction and provenance are findable without spelunking the worklog.

## Scope

- `README.md` - reference `docs/CLASSIC_POWERUP_WEAPON_RESEARCH.md` and the new power-ups/weapons.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` - section 4.4 (Power-ups and Weapons) and section 8 (Future Scope) reflect the new roster and the deferral note.
- Any power-up/weapon design or gym-parity documentation in `docs/` gains references to the research document and the new entries.
- Verify the per-concept code comments added by the concept children are present and accurate.

## Key Files

- `README.md` - Updated. Roster / research-document reference.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` - Updated. Section 4.4 and section 8.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` / gym-parity docs - Updated where they enumerate the arsenal or parity rule.
- `src/powerUpWeaponRosterDocs.test.ts` - New docs guard for the cross-links.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the research and the implemented concepts, including code comments, `README.md`, `docs/Game Design Document.md` sections 4.4/8, and any relevant wiki or docs-site entries.
- A docs guard test asserts the README and the Game Design Document each reference `docs/CLASSIC_POWERUP_WEAPON_RESEARCH.md` and that the arsenal documentation lists the implemented concepts; the guard fails if a cross-link is removed.
- Full project test suite passes with the documentation changes.
